title: Fortnite Is Adding These Iconic Game Of Thrones Characters Soon, It Seems
description: Fortnite's next big crossover is with Game of Thrones, it seems. A report from the Epic-partnered "leak" account ShiinaBR states that the popular characters Daenerys Targaryen, Jon Snow, and The Night King are all coming to Fortnite on March 20 as part of Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 2. This is the first time that Game of Thrones characters are coming to Fortnite. Numerous other characters and franchises owned by Warner Bros. have been added to Fortnite before, including Mortal Kombat, Harry Potter, and Batman. With Game of Thrones now heading to Fortnite, that leaves at least one big omission from the WB stable: The Lord the Rings. To date, no LOTR characters have appeared in Fortnite, but that could be something to do with the rights being a tad more complicated given that Embracer owns the gaming rights. Sony Will Drop All PlayStation Network Branding This Year - Report
description: Sony has reportedly announced plans to retire all PlayStation Network branding by September 2026, according to a leaked email that was sent to developers (via '). "We'd like to inform you that Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) has strategically decided to phase out the terms 'PlayStation Network' and 'PSN' across our platform in order to properly capture the breadth of our evolving digital services," the email reportedly reads. It's not immediately clear what Sony means with regard to properly capturing "the breadth of [its] evolving digital services," but it could be a sign that Sony is trying to move away from being seen as a company that only makes console games, especially given the fact that its next-gen competition is Microsoft's mysterious Xbox PC/console platform, Project Helix. But according to the email, Sony doesn't plan to get rid of PSN itself--it's just getting a new name. Continue Reading at GameSpot

Ex-Overwatch Dev's New FPS Action Game Opens For Testing Soon, How To Sign Up
description: The new game from former Overwatch director Jeff Kaplan, The Legend of California, will hold its first public playtest very soon. Developer Kintsugiyama has announced an alpha test for The Legend of California, and it will be held March 26-30 on Steam. This is not an open test available to everyone, however. People can sign up for the test by visiting the main store page and clicking the [Request Access] button. This will be a "very small" test, the developer said, and that means not everyone who signs will get in. It will take up about 50GB of space, and an SSD is required. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: The Movie That Inspired Mortal Kombat's Testicular Destruction Is Getting An A24 Remake
description: Get ready for a Kumite, as a remake of Bloodsport is in production. This new spin on the 1988 film that launched Jean-Claude Van Damme's career as an action star will be written and directed by I May Destroy You creator Michaela Coel for A24 Films. This will be the third time that Coel has collaborated with the famed film company, following her work on the mini-series First Day on Earth and Mother Mary. "I have long been in awe of fighters, and astounded by the discipline, intensity, and isolation the sport demands of them," Coel said to Variety. "I am excited to explore this world, especially so with A24 as my collaborators. Let's f***ing go." The original Bloodsport was inspired by Frank Dux's stories about competing in a secret underground tournament. None of Dux's claims--such as 329 straight victories, 56 consecutive knockouts, or organizers using high-speed cameras to track his lightning-fast kicks--have ever been proven, but the story still made for an entertaining film. The movie’s theme song, Fight to Survive, performed by Stan Bush, also helped boost its popularity at the box office. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Jim Carrey Is Back For Sonic The Hedgehog 4, With Big Stars In Tow
description: As the live-action Sonic the Hedgehog 4 movie ramps up production, we finally have official confirmation that Jim Carrey (among other stars) is returning to the franchise, and he'll be joined by other prolific Hollywood actors new to the series. Per Variety (and initially reported by DanielRPK), Carrey will don the mustache and goggles yet again as Dr. Robotnik, Variety also reported that Idris Elba (Knuckles), Keanu Reeves (Shadow), Colleen O’Shaughnessey (Tails), James Marsden (Tom Wachowski), Tika Sumpter (Maddie Wachowski), and Lee Majdoub (Agent Stone) are returning as well. Additionally, Ben Kingsley and Nick Offerman are voicing characters, while Matt Berry and Richard Ayoade also join the cast. Ben Schwartz is back as the eponymous blue blur himself, while Kristen Bell voices Amy Rose. An official "title reveal" video features images of returning characters Sonic, Dr. Robotnik, Tails, Knuckles, Shadow, and the Wachowskis, while an orchestral take of the Sonic CD theme song "Sonic Boom" plays in the background. The video puts quite a focus on Bell's Amy Rose (and her hammer) and implies that Metal Sonic will be the movie's villain. Quite obviously, the title is revealed to be ... "Sonic the Hedgehog 4." Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: A Bunch Of Game-Breaking Bugs Just Got Fixed In Pokemon Pokopia
description: You might have been facing progression issues in Pokopia recently that have prevented you from enjoying the game to its full potential. Now, a new Pokopia update has rolled out that fixes those issues, along with some other lesser-known problems that you may not have even noticed. There are several in-game tasks that were blocked by a set of circumstances you may not even have figured out. While in the Bleak Beach--one of the game's later areas--attempting to complete the Find the Pokemon Center! quest for Professor Tangrowth had some players stumped. It turns out that if the cracked blocks on the bridge were broken before the Professor had the chance to cross it, the request would become difficult to progress. Similarly, a "specific sequence of actions" would also prevent the bridge-repair quest from triggering, meaning you couldn't continue the main story. Problems occurred in the early game too. In the Withered Wasteland, Squirtle had a tendency to accidentally climb a nearby tree, making him impossible to talk to, and hindering progress there. In Rocky Ridges, the Clear Off the Path! quest could have progression blocked "under certain conditions" and occasionally the story-essential CD-playing Rotom wouldn't appear for you to meet. If you're further through Pokopia's main story, you'll know that's pretty much a game-breaking problem. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: How The Dark Knight Returns Defined Modern Batman And The Best Ways To Experience It Today
description: The Dark Knight Returns graphic novels and Blu-rays Celebrate 40 years of the landmark Batman series See at Amazon This year marks the 40th anniversary of The Dark Knight Returns, a landmark storyline that redefined Batman for the modern age. written and illustrated by the team of Frank Miller, Klaus Janson, and Lynn Varley, the four-issue mini-series is still a must-read adventure that follows an older Batman as he comes out of retirement to face off against several of his iconic rogues and mutant gangs that have emerged on the streets of Gotham. If you've never read it or you're looking to rediscover the gritty storyline, there are plenty of options available, from reprints of the mini-series to animated adaptations. Here's a closer look at what you can pick up currently. The Dark Knight Returns graphic novels The celebrated saga that is credited for transforming Batman's image from campy Caped Crusader back to a hard-boiled vigilante, this has been in print as a collected-edition graphic novel for many years now. The 30th Anniversary Edition paperback is the cheapest option at $12.82 (was $30), and a DC Compact Comics Edition will be released on April 7 and is priced at $10. This is part of DC's line of new pocket-friendly graphic novels, so if you're looking for some affordable reading material for your morning commute, it's a good option. If you feel like spoiling yourself, you can also pick up The Dark Knight Returns Slipcase Set for $38.21 (was $50). Inside, you'll find all four volumes of The Dark Knight Returns in a hardcover format, housed inside a deluxe slipcase cover that features Frank Miller's iconic artwork. An Absolute Edition of The Dark Knight Returns that includes the sequel series The Dark Knight Strikes Again is also available, and it includes additional commentary on the stories. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Legacy Of Kain Fans Can Now Preorder A Stunning Map Of Nosgoth
description: The Legacy of Kain series is steadily making a comeback after decades of hibernation. We've seen ports and remasters of classic games in the series like Soul Reaver and Legacy of Kain: Defiance, as well as a new spin-off game, Legacy of Kain: Ascendance, launching later this month. These releases have been bolstered by graphic novels and other content that flesh out the world-building of the cult-classic vampire fantasy series, including an all-new Legacy of Kain: Map of Nosgoth, coming soon from graphic novel publisher Dark Horse. Illustrated by renowned artist Francesca Baerald, the Nosgoth map pulls landmarks, regions, and fan-favorite characters from across the entire Legacy of Kain series to create a unique work of cartographic art. Priced at $50, it's now available to preorder exclusively through the Dark Horse Direct Store ahead of its release, which is tentatively planned for late Spring 2025. Legacy of Kain: Map of Nosgoth Fine Art Print $50 | Releases Q2 2026 Gallery After centuries of conflict, the map reflects the state of Nosgoth and the brutal wars it has endured, with iconic locations like the horrific gardens at Dark Eden to the nine Pillars of Nosgoth featured on it. Each corner of the map is also anchored by iconic heroes and adversaries, such as Raziel (top right), Kain, Janos Audron, Vorador (top left), Moebius (bottom right), Mortanius (bottom left), and Ariel (bottom center). As an added touch, the Elder God extends his arms and watchful eyes along the print's borders. Continue Reading at GameSpot
